Suggested itinerary

Day 1

Arrival and marine experience

Settle in and enjoy the place. Then head out on the whale watching tour along the Los Órganos coast, and return to relax with an afternoon by the sea.

Day 2

Breakfast and turtles

Start with a delicious breakfast, then swim with sea turtles, always following the operators’ guidance and respecting their habitat. Free time before you head home.

Humpback whales are mainly seen from July to October. Outside the season, ask us what alternatives there are for your dates.

More activities

Ask us about these activities when you book and we will point you in the right direction.

  • Sunset paddle
  • Yoga
  • Bus tour
  • Surf lessons
  • Kitesurf lessons
